frames.title: Does the planned session still fit?
Same lifts. Two sets, not four.
Form slips? That's the last set.
Mobility, a walk, or rest. All decisions.

slides.title: Broken night, but you feel strangely wired?
slides.body: A buzzy morning isn't always a full tank.

slides.title: Buzzing is not the same as usable energy
slides.body: Record how you feel. Don't treat it as a green light yet.

slides.title: Could I do this session well, not just start it?
slides.body: Starting is easy when you're wired. Finishing well is the test.

slides.title: Pick a modest starting point
slides.body: The first ten minutes at an easy pace.

slides.title: A clear stop cue
slides.body: Heavy legs, clumsy form or a sudden dip. Then you're done.

slides.title: Ask again at ten minutes
slides.body: Wired energy can fade fast. Adjust without drama.

slides.title: Works on flat mornings and buzzy ones
slides.body:
Guide + printable decision card.
